method: TIM2 (PSC=0) CNT and DWT CYCCNT counted over 1 ms virtual time, on an empty platform vs. after the P0 firmware ran SystemClock_Config (RunFor 0.2 s)
conclusion: Renode's STM32H7_RCC re-times SysTick and timers from the firmware's clock config (TIM2 = 200 MHz = CubeMX); the .repl's 250 MHz is a start value. DWT stays at 250 MHz (board: 400 MHz CPU) -> cycle counts off by 1.6x.
found_by: owner, M7 learning lab 6 (contradicted the earlier claim in fa4c047, which came from a run with no firmware loaded)
